title: Bean Steamer
html:
Quest Giver: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Head down to Balzack's Burrow Level 2 and see if you can find out how they are infusing the coffee beans.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Javier Waldez the Java Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Madachino

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head down to Balzack's Burrow Level 2 and see if you can find out how they are infusing the coffee beans.

Offer:

The frothy head, the terrible smell, the way it seems to cause boils to form on the tip of the tongue. I wonder how they are causing these properties of the FizzRock to fuse so well with the coffee bean. This has to be the reason Karlbucks is selling so much more coffee than me. The stuff tastes terrible to us, but those monsters sure love it.

Head down to Balzack's Burrow Level 2 and see if you can find out how they are infusing the coffee beans. If you can't find out how they are doing it then don't bother coming back here. I will probably have not even sold one cup of Joe by then, and that means that not only will I starve, but my family of pet whiskers will too. The poor little things, they are always running around the dungeon I rent. I bet you didn't even know that I rented a dungeon did you. Well see you're not so smart after all are you?

I really need to sell some of this coffee, I need to pay rent on the dungeon, the cart, and the grass I am standing on here. I have an idea, the longer you stand there and don't go find out how they are infusing the coffee the more I am going to charge you as a sub-letting fee.

If you do come back, I will still be here you know, well maybe, we already went over that. If I am not here at Balzacks Base Camp, I will be in Whisker Kopi Luwak Land.

Turn-in:

I must figure a way to make my coffee even better than this. I am going to need some time to figure a brilliant plan. Come back some other time and I might give you some of the new coffee.

Objectives:

  • Fizz-Rock Infused Beans ×1

Level range: 55–100
